title: A member learns the phone is out of space only after a workout save has already failed
what: The app has one line for a full phone: 'Couldn't save, your phone's storage may be full', shown only once a save has failed. Nothing checks free space beforehand, so a member in the middle of a workout finds out too late, and until they free space the sets they log are not stored on the phone.
expected: A quiet early note when the phone's free space gets low, before saving starts to fail.
how_often: rarely: only when the phone's storage runs out
fix_line: Check free space at app start and show a calm early note when it is low
